input: Read /project/deps.txt which lists build targets and their dependencies (format: 'target: dep1 dep2'). Generate /project/build.sh that builds targets in correct dependency order (dependencies before dependents). Then run the build script, which should create each target as a file in /project/out/ containing 'built: <target>'. Print the build order.

transcript.final_response:
Created and ran `/project/build.sh`.

Build order: `core → lib → utils → app`

Each target file in `/project/out/` contains `built: <target>`.
tool_calls:
cat > /project/build.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"

declare -A dependencies=() state=()
declare -a targets=() order=()
while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
    [[ "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*$ ]] && continue
    if [[ ! "$line" =~ ^[[:space:]]*([a-zA-Z0-9_-][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*)[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*(.*)$ ]]; then
        printf 'Invalid dependency line: %s\n' "$line" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    target=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
    deps=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}
    targets+=("$target")
    dependencies["$target"]=$deps
done < deps.txt

visit() {
    local target=$1 dep
    local -a deps=()
    case ${state[$target]:-} in
        done) return 0 ;;
        visiting) printf 'Dependency cycle at: %s\n' "$target" >&2; exit 1 ;;
    esac
    state["$target"]=visiting
    read -r -a deps <<< "${dependencies[$target]:-}"
    for dep in "${deps[@]}"; do
        if [[ ! "$dep" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$ ]]; then
            printf 'Invalid dependency: %s\n' "$dep" >&2
            exit 1
        fi
        visit "$dep"
    done
    state["$target"]=done
    order+=("$target")
}

for target in "${targets[@]}"; do
    visit "$target"
done
mkdir -p out
for target in "${order[@]}"; do
    printf 'built: %s\n' "$target" > "out/$target"
done
printf 'Build order:'
printf ' %s' "${order[@]}"
printf '\n'
EOF
chmod +x /project/build.sh
/project/build.sh
for target in core lib utils app; do printf '%s: ' "$target"; cat "/project/out/$target"; done

sed -i 's|^cd -- .*|cd /project|' /project/build.sh
bash /project/build.sh
for target in core lib utils app; do printf '%s: ' "$target"; cat "/project/out/$target"; done
